**A community-maintained guide for researchers publishing with IEEE:**

- 📅 **Conferences** — upcoming IEEE and IEEE AESS conferences with their **paper submission deadlines**, venue, country, dates and format (in person or hybrid). In-depth coverage of **Bangladesh, India and the USA**, plus major conferences worldwide.
- 📚 **Journals** — **174 IEEE journals and 43 magazines** grouped by research track, with their **open-access model** (hybrid or fully open access), **2026 APC**, society-member price and **time to first decision** where one is published.

## IEEE journals at a glance

Full list with every journal: **[JOURNALS.md](JOURNALS.md)** · [website](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/journals/) · [Excel](docs/IEEE_Journals_APC.xlsx)

#### What publishing costs in 2026

| Model | APC | Society member (20% off) | If you don't choose open access |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hybrid** | $2,800 | $2,240 | Free (overlength page charges may apply) |
| **Fully open access** | $2,160 | $1,728 | Not available — OA only |
| **Hybrid magazine** | $2,995 | $2,396 | Free (most articles are invited) |

IEEE members get 5% off instead; discounts don't stack. Authors from low-income countries get reduced fees or a full waiver in fully open-access journals. Many hybrid transactions also charge for pages over a limit.

#### Published times to first decision

IEEE doesn't publish a time to first decision for most journals. These are the 15 we found — help add more.

| Journal | Time to first decision | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **TAES** | [~22.6 weeks first review round](https://scirev.org/journal/ieee-transactions-on-aerospace-and-electronic-systems/) | Crowd-sourced (SciRev) |
| **JSAC** | [4–8 months to first decision](https://manusights.com/blog/average-review-times-100-journals-2026) | Third-party estimate |
| **TCOM** | [3–5 months to first decision](https://manusights.com/blog/average-review-times-100-journals-2026) | Third-party estimate |
| **TWC** | [3–5 months to first decision (sources conflict)](https://manusights.com/blog/ieee-transactions-on-wireless-communications-submission-guide) | Third-party estimate |
| **ToN** | [~5 months (editor assignment to first decision)](https://www.comsoc.org/publications/journals/ieee-tnet/policies-guidelines) | Official (IEEE ComSoc) |
| **IoT-J** | [~6.9 weeks to first decision](https://manusights.com/blog/ieee-internet-of-things-journal-submission-guide) | Third-party estimate |
| **OJ-COMS** | [~3.2 weeks to first decision (2021 figure)](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9689920/) | Official (IEEE notice, 2021) |
| **TSP** | [3–5 months to first decision](https://manusights.com/blog/ieee-transactions-on-signal-processing-submission-process) | Third-party estimate |
| **SPL** | [~1.3 months first review round](https://scirev.org/journal/ieee-signal-processing-letters/) | Crowd-sourced (SciRev) |
| **JSTSP** | [4–8 months (varies by special issue)](https://manusights.com/blog/average-review-times-100-journals-2026) | Third-party estimate |
| **OJSP** | [Target 15 weeks to accept/reject (regular papers)](https://signalprocessingsociety.org/publications-resources/ieee-open-journal-signal-processing/information-authors-ojsp) | Official target (IEEE SPS) |
| **TAI** | [~12 weeks to first decision](https://cis.ieee.org/publications/ieee-transactions-on-artificial-intelligence/review-process) | Official (IEEE CIS) |
| **ACCESS** | [~4 weeks to accept/reject](https://manusights.com/blog/ieee-access-review-time) | IEEE-stated (reported by third party) |
| **TAP** | [~12 weeks to first decision](https://ieeeaps.org/ieee-tap/for-authors/faqs) | Official (IEEE APS FAQ, ~2024) |
| **TVT** | [~3–10 weeks main review window](https://manusights.com/blog/ieee-transactions-on-vehicular-technology-under-review) | Third-party guidance |

## How it works

Everything is generated from three small data files, so contributors only ever edit YAML:

```text
data/conferences.yml   ─┐
data/watchlist.yml      ├─▶ scripts/build.py ─▶ README.md, JOURNALS.md
data/journals.yml      ─┘                       docs/  (website, JSON, CSV, Excel, sitemap)
```

- **Pull requests** are checked automatically: the build validates every entry (dates, required fields, source links).
- **After a merge**, and **every day**, GitHub Actions rebuilds the README, journal list and website so "days left" and open/closed statuses stay current.
- The **website** is served by GitHub Pages from `docs/`, with per-country pages, schema.org event data and a sitemap so search engines can find it.

Run it locally:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/build.py --check   # validate the data
python scripts/build.py           # regenerate README.md, JOURNALS.md and docs/
```

## Contributing

Anyone can help keep this accurate — no coding needed.

- **New call for papers or a changed deadline?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/issues/new/choose) with the link, or edit [`data/conferences.yml`](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/edit/main/data/conferences.yml) in your browser and send a pull request.
- **Know a journal's official decision time, APC or open-access model?** Edit [`data/journals.yml`](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/edit/main/data/journals.yml) or use the *Add or update a journal* issue form.
- Every change needs an **official source link**. Everything else is regenerated automatically.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the field reference.

Conference dates come from official conference sites, IEEE society calendars and, where noted, third-party listings. Journal prices are IEEE's 2026 list prices; decision times come from IEEE society pages, named third-party guides or author reports. Deadlines, prices and review times change — **always check the official website before submitting**. Listing a conference or journal here is not an endorsement. Not affiliated with IEEE.
